sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:2

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:2:1
items.html: There are seven corrections in this Rosh, etc.: Namely, from the illumination of the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik that shine in them. These are the seven Sefirot HGT NHYM, and their explanation will be explained below.
